options.content:
**Régime 1a : taux de réception (PDR) vers la gateway fixe.** Calculé toutes les 10 min par le traitement du serveur (`LoRaWAN-Infra/regime1a/`), avec le même code que `Mote/src/bilan_regime_1a.py`. Période comptée à l'heure près, depuis le 6 novembre 2026 à 11:53. Exclusions E1 à E5 retirées (E5 : chevauchement entre deux motes de l'expérience) (règle du plan, section 10) ; le sélecteur « Heures E3 » permet de les garder. Heures en heure de Paris.

**Motifs d'exclusion** — **E1** : gateway sans statistiques plus de 75 s (coupure) · **E2** : relance de la LoRa de la gateway (30 s) · **E3** : heure de réception dégradée (trames des autres réseaux LoRa trop faibles ou trop rares) · **E4** : intervention documentée (`docs/exclusions-e4.csv`) · **E5** : émission qui chevauche celle d'une autre mote de l'expérience.

panels.title: PDR par mote et par SF (période sélectionnée)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE host WHEN 'pi-mote-1' THEN 'Mote 1 · témoin (IRIT)' WHEN 'pi-mote-2' THEN 'Mote 2 · Forum' WHEN 'pi-mote-3' THEN 'Mote 3' WHEN 'pi-mote-4' THEN 'Mote 4 · CBI' WHEN 'pi-mote-5' THEN 'Mote 5 · 4R1' WHEN 'pi-mote-6' THEN 'Mote 6' ELSE host END AS "Mote",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 7) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 7), 0), 1) AS "SF7",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 8) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 8), 0), 1) AS "SF8",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 9) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 9), 0), 1) AS "SF9",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 10) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 10), 0), 1) AS "SF10",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 11) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 11), 0), 1) AS "SF11",
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 12) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) FILTER (WHERE sf = 12), 0), 1) AS "SF12",
  sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END) AS "Émissions comptées",
  sum(excluded) AS "Émissions exclues"
FROM regime_1a_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour)
GROUP BY host
ORDER BY host

panels.title: PDR en SF$sf par mote (agrégé par $agregation)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(hour, $agregation),
  CASE host WHEN 'pi-mote-1' THEN 'Mote 1 · témoin (IRIT)' WHEN 'pi-mote-2' THEN 'Mote 2 · Forum' WHEN 'pi-mote-3' THEN 'Mote 3' WHEN 'pi-mote-4' THEN 'Mote 4 · CBI' WHEN 'pi-mote-5' THEN 'Mote 5 · 4R1' WHEN 'pi-mote-6' THEN 'Mote 6' ELSE host END AS metric,
  100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN received ELSE received_without_e3 END) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN '$e3' = 'exclues' THEN sent ELSE sent_without_e3 END), 0) AS "PDR"
FROM regime_1a_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND sf = $sf
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: État des motes et de la collecte

targets.rawSql:
WITH tx AS (SELECT host, dev_eui, max(utc) AS last_tx FROM regime_1a_tx GROUP BY 1, 2),
     rx AS (SELECT dev_eui, max(received_at) AS last_rx FROM uplinks WHERE received_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1),
     col AS (SELECT host, max(utc) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS last_ok FROM regime_1a_collection GROUP BY 1),
     rec AS (SELECT host, max(utc) AS last_recover,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE detail LIKE '%resync%' AND $__timeFilter(utc)) AS n
             FROM regime_1a_events WHERE event = 'recover' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CASE host WHEN 'pi-mote-1' THEN 'Mote 1 · témoin (IRIT)' WHEN 'pi-mote-2' THEN 'Mote 2 · Forum' WHEN 'pi-mote-3' THEN 'Mote 3' WHEN 'pi-mote-4' THEN 'Mote 4 · CBI' WHEN 'pi-mote-5' THEN 'Mote 5 · 4R1' WHEN 'pi-mote-6' THEN 'Mote 6' ELSE host END AS "Mote",
  round(extract(epoch FROM now() - rx.last_rx) / 60) AS "Dernière réception (min)",
  round(extract(epoch FROM now() - tx.last_tx) / 60) AS "Dernière émission journalisée (min)",
  round(extract(epoch FROM now() - col.last_ok) / 60) AS "Dernière collecte réussie (min)",
  coalesce(rec.n, 0) AS "Reprises auto (période)",
  rec.last_recover AS "Dernière reprise auto"
FROM tx LEFT JOIN rx USING (dev_eui) LEFT JOIN col USING (host) LEFT JOIN rec USING (host)
ORDER BY host

panels.title: Fenêtres d'exclusion (période sélectionnée)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rule AS "Motif", CASE rule WHEN 'E1' THEN 'Gateway sans statistiques plus de 75 s (coupure)' WHEN 'E2' THEN 'Relance de la LoRa de la gateway (30 s)' WHEN 'E3' THEN 'Heure de réception dégradée (trames étrangères trop faibles ou trop rares)' WHEN 'E4' THEN 'Intervention documentée (docs/exclusions-e4.csv)' ELSE rule END AS "Signification", start_at AS "Début", end_at AS "Fin",
  round(extract(epoch FROM end_at - start_at)) AS "Durée (s)"
FROM regime_1a_exclusions
WHERE start_at < $__timeTo() AND end_at > $__timeFrom()
ORDER BY start_at DESC

panels.description: Règle d'exclusion du plan expérimental (section 10). E1 : gateway sans statistiques plus de 75 s. E2 : relance de la LoRa (30 s). E3 : heure de réception dégradée. E4 : intervention documentée. E5 (chevauchement entre deux motes de l'expérience) exclut des émissions une à une : pas de fenêtre ici.

panels.title: Gateway fixe : statistiques reçues par heure

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, 1h), count(*) AS "Statistiques reçues (120 attendues par heure)"
FROM gateway_events
WHERE event_type = 'stats' AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
